questions.text: In trajectory2a99f536 at state3, what date is actually shown in the From field? Give the observed MM/DD/YYYY value, not the intended action value.
In trajectory2a99f536 at state4, what date is shown in the From field? Use state4, not the previous state3, and answer MM/DD/YYYY.
In trajectory2a99f536 at state4, what date is shown in the To field? Answer MM/DD/YYYY.
In trajectory12c22166 at state4 before Order Now is clicked, what quantity is actually selected in the Quantity combobox? Give only the number, not the requested action value.
In trajectory12c22166 at state4 before Order Now, what subtotal is visibly displayed? Give the dollar amount without a dollar sign or thousands separator, with two decimal places.
In trajectory12c22166 at state5 on the final Order Status page, what quantity is listed for Apple Watch? Use state5, not the preceding selection state4, and give only the number.
